subject: Novacorp evaluation readiness & KPI commitments
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Anya Petrova <anya@novacorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Novacorp evaluation readiness & KPI commitments

Hi Anya —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we spin up the sandbox: 

Summary of what we discussed
- Goal: validate that Redwood can meet Novacorp's real-time extraction workload (invoice-line extraction + classification) at production cost targets while keeping hallucination and false positives within your risk tolerance.
- Scope: Sandboxed trial using a representative subset of 5k anonymized invoices + a second validation set (2k) you select.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency <= 200 ms for single-record extraction under representative token lengths.
- Throughput: sustained throughput of 20 inference requests/sec for standard batch window; burst to 50 rps tolerated for short peaks.
- Cost: model cost <= $0.002 / token (measured across the validation set end-to-end).
- Quality: extraction F1 >= 0.78 on your labeled validation set; key-field hallucination rate < 2% (ops definition: any confidently returned field that is not present in the input).
- Reliability: service availability >= 99.5% during the pilot window.

Evaluation plan & owners
- Week 0 (this week): finalize dataset, sign SOW/NDA, set up access. (Owner: Anya / Novacorp procurement)
- Week 1–2: Redwood sandbox (isolate workspace, telemetry, and KV caching enabled). (Owner: Karthik / Redwood SE)
- Week 3: Run validation pass + compute metrics; joint review and acceptance. (Owner: Monica for metric definitions; Anya for acceptance decision)

Operational asks from Novacorp to enable the trial
- Provide the 5k anonymized sample + validation set by EOD Thurs (Mar 4).
- Confirm whether SOC2 evidence exchange will be required during the trial (procurement).
- Point us at an internal owner for post-trial rollout decisions.

Next steps (proposed)
1) I will send the sandbox access request and the SOW draft (attached) — please review and flag any procurement/ legal issues.
2) Monica will share a short measurement template to populate labels and expected output.
3) Schedule a 30‑minute kickoff for next Tuesday (Mar 2) to confirm dataset and measurement plan.

Attachments: novacorp-eval-outline.pdf, redwood-poc-sla-draft.docx

If any of the success criteria above need adjustment (for example if you need a stricter latency SLO), call it out and we can rework the test plan.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Appreciate the clear summary. This aligns closely with what we discussed; a few clarifications and one adjustment from our side: 

1) Dataset timing — we can get the 5k anonymized sample to you by EOD Friday (Mar 5) rather than Mar 4. Our labeling team needs one extra day.
2) Latency target — 200 ms 95th is reasonable. Can you confirm measurements exclude network hop to our test harness? We need to be clear whether 95th is measured end-to-end or only at the model node.
3) Cost — $0.002/token target is fine to evaluate; procurement will request a breakdown of model, infra, and orchestration costs in the SOW.
4) Please add our procurement lead (Procurement Team) on the SOW review and we will route questions there.

We are good to proceed subject to the SOW and a short kickoff call. Please send calendar invites for Tue Mar 2 10:00 PT if that works.

Thanks,

Hi Anya / team —

Thanks for the confirmation and the dataset timing update. Quick responses and a tightened execution plan from our side: 

Measurement nuance (latency)
- We will report both model-node latency and end-to-end latency (from your test harness to response). For the acceptance gate we recommend model-node 95th <= 180 ms and end-to-end 95th <= 230 ms to allow for network variance. We’ll show both graphs in the readout.

Cost breakdown in SOW
- The attached SOW draft includes an appendix with line-item estimates: model compute, orchestration, storage, and telemetry. Ben — can you add the burst pricing band we discussed?

Acceptance criteria & ownership (finalized)
- Latency (model-node 95th): <= 180 ms (Owner: Redwood infra team / Ben)
- End-to-end latency (95th): <= 230 ms (Owner: Novacorp test harness)
- Throughput: sustain 20 rps with <5% error rate (Owner: Redwood runtime / Monica)
- Cost: measured blended cost <= $0.002 / token across validation set (Owner: Redwood finance)
- Quality: extraction F1 >= 0.78 on your labeled set; hallucination rate <2% (Owner: Novacorp QA with Redwood SE support)

Measurement method
- We will use the attached measurement-template.csv to collect predicted vs. gold labels; metrics will be computed using the script linked in the Drive (see related links).

Updated timeline (proposed)
- Mar 5: Redwood receives anonymized sample + validation set (Novacorp)
- Mar 8: Sandbox access granted; instrumentation enabled (Redwood)
- Mar 9–15: Run batch validation + telemetry collection (joint)
- Mar 16: Readout and acceptance decision

Kickoff meeting
- Karthik scheduled Tue Mar 2 at 10:00 PT — Monica will share calendar invite and agenda.

Attachments: measurement-template.csv (small CSV you can use to map fields)

If procurement has SOW redlines please send them prior to the kickoff so legal can be looped in.

Best,
